articles.title: OpenAI’s cozy partner Cerebras is on track for a blockbuster IPO
articles.summary: AI chip maker Cerebras is heading for a blockbuster IPO that could value it at $26.6 billion or more. Its relationship with OpenAI is deep and rich.

articles.title: Image AI models now drive app growth, beating chatbot upgrades
articles.summary: Appfigures finds visual model launches generate 6.5x more downloads — but most don’t convert that spike into revenue.

articles.title: GameStop offers $56 billion for eBay, struggles to explain how it'll pay for it
articles.summary: Amid falling revenue and store closures, GameStop wants to buy the much larger eBay.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s only AI expert witness at the OpenAI trial fears an AGI arms race
articles.summary: Stuart Russell is a long-time AI researcher who thinks governments need to restrain frontier labs.

articles.title: ‘This is fine’ creator says AI startup stole his art
articles.summary: The ad comes from Artisan, the AI startup behind billboards urging businesses to "stop hiring humans."

articles.title: In Harvard study, AI offered more accurate emergency room diagnoses than two human doctors
articles.summary: A new study examines how large language models perform in a variety of medical contexts, including real emergency room cases — where at least one model seemed to be more accurate than human doctors.
